entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A system or approach that utilizes graph data for retrieval and generation.

entities.name: Wikidata
entities.description: A free and open knowledge base storing structured data from Wikimedia sister projects like Wikipedia.

entities.name: Freebase
entities.description: An extensive, collaboratively edited knowledge base compiling data from various sources including Wikipedia.

entities.name: DBpedia
entities.description: A knowledge graph representing information about millions of entities by leveraging Wikipedia infoboxes and categories.

entities.name: YAGO
entities.description: A knowledge graph that collects knowledge from Wikipedia, WordNet, and GeoNames.

entities.name: Wikipedia
entities.description: A source of structured data and infoboxes used to construct other knowledge graphs like DBpedia and YAGO.

entities.name: WordNet
entities.description: A lexical database used as a source for the YAGO knowledge graph.

entities.name: GeoNames
entities.description: A geographical database used as a source for the YAGO knowledge graph.

entities.name: General Knowledge Graphs
entities.description: A category of knowledge graphs storing general, structured knowledge from collective input.
